count.label: Polaroids
count.description: How many previous wallpapers to show.

random.label: Random pictures
random.description: Show random pictures from the wallpaper folder instead of the previous wallpapers; drawn again when the wallpaper changes.

folder.label: Picture folder
folder.description: Random pictures from this folder (top level). Empty: the wallpaper folder.

interval.label: Refresh every (minutes)
interval.description: New pictures and positions on a timer. 0: only when the wallpaper changes. Above 0: only on the timer.
